name: stateset-icommerce
description: Embedded commerce engine for AI agents: orders, inventory, payments, returns, subscriptions, finance. Local SQLite, no API keys, exact-decimal money with enforced invariants.
long_description: Gives your agent a complete local commerce backend: orders, inventory, customers, products, carts and checkout, payments and refunds, returns/RMA, subscriptions, analytics, and a full finance suite. Everything runs in-process against a local SQLite file — no accounts, no API keys, no rate limits. Money is exact-decimal and guarded by enforced invariants (an agent cannot over-refund, over-capture, or oversell), and writes are preview-only until you pass --apply.
